content.comment_body: Hello everyone, your ongoing support is greatly valued. How many VPN channels can be activated simultaneously for the [product_name] Mobile Communication Module ([product_name] 2020)? Are there any restrictions on the number of VPN channels? I successfully established one VPN channel, but I am interested in knowing if multiple connections are possible. Any guidance would be appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: User is asking for details about the maximum number of concurrently active VPN channels supported by the [product_name] Mobile Communication Module. The main usability concern is the lack of clear information in the documentation or technical specifications regarding support for multiple VPN connections.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to have the ability to enable several VPN channels at the same time and is looking for explicit details on any such restrictions.
